wren_wake.speaker: wren
wren_wake.text: Oh, thank the light, you're awake. You were lying in the meadow with your lantern still burning. That's no small thing, these days.

wren_premise.speaker: wren
wren_premise.text: The Lumen Cores under the hills are failing. Every night the dark comes up a little further. The keeper went down to find out why, and never came back.

wren_task_tree.speaker: wren
wren_task_tree.text: If you mean to help, you'll need tools, and tools need wood. Take a swing at one of those trees. Keep at it until it comes down.

wren_task_wood.speaker: wren
wren_task_wood.text: Good, it's down! Now gather up the wood. Walk over the logs and they're yours. Ten pieces should do it.

wren_task_workbench.speaker: wren
wren_task_workbench.text: Ten pieces. Open your pack and make a workbench. Everything worth having starts at a workbench.

wren_task_place.speaker: wren
wren_task_place.text: Now set it down somewhere flat. Hold it in your hand and tap the ground where it should go.

wren_task_stone.speaker: wren
wren_task_stone.text: Your bench needs stone as much as wood. Dig into the rock with your pickaxe. Six stones.

wren_task_axe.speaker: wren
wren_task_axe.text: Now, a proper axe. A pickaxe chops like a spoon digs. Make a wooden axe at your bench and the trees will come down twice as fast.

wren_task_build.speaker: wren
wren_task_build.text: One last thing. The cottage roof is half gone. Put up six blocks of anything, stone, planks, dirt even, and you'll have built your first wall.

wren_task_return.speaker: wren
wren_task_return.text: Come and talk to me when it's up.

wren_done_first.speaker: wren
wren_done_first.text: Look at you. A Lanternbearer with calluses. Take this flask, it'll feed your lantern when the dark presses close. Old Bram at the mine can teach you the rest.

wren_idle.speaker: wren
wren_idle.text: Stay where the light is, when you can. And when you can't, carry it with you.

wren_ward_offer.speaker: wren
wren_ward_offer.text: Bram tells me you've been below. Then you've felt it, the cold that eats your light. A wardstone holds it back. Glowshards, stone and a ruby, worked at an anvil.

wren_ward_done.speaker: wren
wren_ward_done.text: It's beautiful. The dark won't settle anywhere near that stone. You've made a little island of safety. Make more.

wren_gloam_offer.speaker: wren
wren_gloam_offer.text: Two cores were failing, Bram says. One under the ruins, one in the crystal hollows. Something lives in the hollows, something that eats light. The keeper called it the Gloam.

wren_gloam_done.speaker: wren
wren_gloam_done.text: The hollows are singing again. I can feel it in the soil. You did it, Lanternbearer. Whatever the keeper started, you've finished.

bram_greet.speaker: bram
bram_greet.text: Hm. Wren's latest, are you? You've got the look. Most folk who come to this mine leave in a hurry, or don't leave at all.

bram_roots_offer.speaker: bram
bram_roots_offer.text: Wooden tools won't scratch what's down there. Get yourself below the roots, forty metres or so, bring up copper and iron, and build yourself an anvil. Then forge a copper pickaxe. Proper metal.

bram_roots_depth.speaker: bram
bram_roots_depth.text: Down you go, then. Mind the drop, and mind the dark even more.

bram_roots_done.speaker: bram
bram_roots_done.text: Now that's a pick. Hear how it rings? That's the sound of rock giving up. You'll go far with that. Deeper, anyway.

bram_warden_offer.speaker: bram
bram_warden_offer.text: There's a vault under the old ruins, with an altar, and a thing that guards it. Rusted iron and bad temper. Find the key in the ruins and wake it, if you're fool enough. The core it sits on is worth it.

bram_warden_done.speaker: bram
bram_warden_done.text: You put the Warden down? Ha! I've been afraid of that pile of scrap for thirty years. Here, you've earned this.

bram_idle.speaker: bram
bram_idle.text: Copper first, then iron, then silver, then gold. The rock tells you what it'll give, if you listen to the pick.

mira_greet.speaker: mira
mira_greet.text: Well, hello there. You must be the one Wren dragged out of the meadow. Hungry? You look hungry. Everyone does, lately.

mira_meal_offer.speaker: mira
mira_meal_offer.text: Here's a trade. Build a campfire, cook me two good pieces of meat, and I'll show you how to make a stew that'll put the colour back in your cheeks.

mira_meal_done.speaker: mira
mira_meal_done.text: Mm, that smells right. Here. Stew for the road. Eat it when the road gets long.

mira_shards_offer.speaker: mira
mira_shards_offer.text: Glowshards grow in the crystal hollows like mushrooms after rain. Bring me six and I'll brew them down into something your lantern will thank you for.

mira_shards_done.speaker: mira
mira_shards_done.text: Six of them, still humming. Hold on. There. Two flasks of liquid light. Don't drink it, mind. It's for the lantern.

mira_idle.speaker: mira
mira_idle.text: Apples in the meadow, meat on the hoof, fish in the pools. The land still feeds us. For now.
